segments.name: omnichannel marketplace
segments.description: Runs an omnichannel marketplace and auction sites for buyers and sellers of commercial assets and vehicles, with related services and data.
segments.evidence: Established in 1958, the Company is a leading, omnichannel marketplace and trusted provider of value-added insights, services and transaction solutions for buyers and sellers of commercial assets and vehicles worldwide.

revenueModel.text: Consignors and buyers pay RB Global commissions, fees and registration charges to sell and buy assets through its auctions and marketplaces.
revenueModel.evidence: Transactional seller revenues, which includes commissions and other fees earned from consignors to facilitate the sale of an asset
